description: This file defines classes and types for handling test reporting and result processing in Playwright, including classes for suites, test cases, results, and a receiver for telemetry events.

classes.name: TeleReporterReceiver
classes.description: Handles telemetry events for test reporting, manages test suites, test cases, and results, and communicates with a reporter interface.

classes.name: TeleSuite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, which can contain nested suites and test cases.

classes.name: TeleTestCase
classes.description: Represents an individual test case with its results, metadata, and hierarchy.

classes.name: TeleTestStep
classes.description: Represents a step within a test result, including timing, errors, and attachments.

classes.name: TeleTestResult
classes.description: Stores the outcome and associated data of a test execution, including status, duration, errors, and attachments.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches incoming telemetry events to appropriate handler methods based on event method type.

methods.name: _onConfigure
methods.description: Handles configuration setup from received event.

methods.name: _onProject
methods.description: Handles project-related telemetry event, updating or creating project suite.

methods.name: _onBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of test run event.

methods.name: _onTestBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test case execution.

methods.name: _onTestEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test case execution, updating results.

methods.name: _onStepBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test step.

methods.name: _onStepEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test step.

methods.name: _onAttach
methods.description: Handles attachment data for a test result.

methods.name: _onTestError
methods.description: Handles an error during test execution.

methods.name: _onError
methods.description: Handles general errors.

methods.name: _onStdIO
methods.description: Handles standard IO data (stdout/stderr) during test execution.

methods.name: _onEnd
methods.description: Handles the completion of the entire test run.

methods.name: _onExit
methods.description: Handles process exit event.

methods.name: _parseConfig
methods.description: Parses and merges configuration data from event.

methods.name: _parseProject
methods.description: Parses project data into internal project representation.

methods.name: _parseAttachments
methods.description: Converts raw attachment data into internal format, decoding base64 if needed.

methods.name: _mergeSuiteInto
methods.description: Merges JSON suite data into internal suite structure.

methods.name: _mergeTestInto
methods.description: Merges JSON test case data into internal test case structure.

methods.name: _updateTest
methods.description: Updates test case properties based on JSON payload.

methods.name: _absoluteAnnotationLocationsInplace
methods.description: Converts annotation locations to absolute paths.

methods.name: _absoluteLocation
methods.description: Converts relative location to absolute location based on root directory.

methods.name: _absolutePath
methods.description: Resolves relative path to absolute path using provided resolvePath function or default concatenation.
